_uwaga: Checklisty z zakładki CHECKLIST; 'open-position' jest też w AERODROME. Format jak w vatiris (github.com/minsulander/vatiris, frontend/src/data/checklist, GPL-3.0): punkt 'Co...AKCJA', sections = {indeks pierwszego punktu: nagłówek}. Dozwolone znaczniki: <b> <i> <tt>.

checklists.label: OPEN
checklists.title: Open position
items: Above/below controllers: open, ready for traffic...COORDINATE
Traffic in sector - <tt>.contactme</tt> or coordinate and transfer

checklists.label: CLOSE
checklists.title: Close position
checklists.preDescription: Plan ahead and avoid overloading above controller if closing with a lot of traffic
items: Above controller: traffic handoff, location, status...COORDINATE
Pilots: contact above/downstream controller or advisory...TRANSMIT & TRANSFER

checklists.label: HANDOVER
checklists.title: Handover/takeover briefing
items: Weather - winds, QNH, TRL, LVP, CB

checklists.label: RWY CHG
checklists.title: Runway change
checklists.preDescription: Runways changes with short notice increase the workload of both pilots and controllers and are due to safety reasons avoided as far as possible.
